summary: The admitted replay reaches C mon.c:newcham while makemon.c:makemon selects the initial form of a natural shapechanger. The C newcham branch calls set_apparxy when mon_moving and the apparent-hero location is stale; js/mon.js makes the same call without importing the already-ported helper from js/monmove.js, causing the recorded ReferenceError.

source.branch: During newcham, context.mon_moving is true and !u_at(mtmp->mux, mtmp->muy), so C refreshes the monster apparent-hero coordinates with set_apparxy.
callers: makemon.c:makemon initializes natural shapechangers with newcham; JS makemon_create.js:makemon calls newcham_initial.
dependencies: monmove.c:set_apparxy is already implemented and exported by js/monmove.js.

evidence: The saved v54 baseline at challenges/evaluations/baseline-78195d815-v54.json reports set_apparxy is not defined for this 778-step recording; recording SHA b8b44533f0920ce54201cb4639f19ae5b6b56fb8ba3173161062128d28595f3c and replay-input SHA 45d90454248a4bc3c97d75d60b021c6c51189f320359df542992f70d10d86993.

A targeted replay at a6bb4eb951db01dd2ab78790fc60ddf1f65a0c0d produced a ReferenceError stack: js/mon.js:3084 apply_newcham_steps -> js/mon.js:3216 newcham_initial -> js/makemon_create.js:3203 makemon.

C makemon.c:1355-1368 invokes newcham for natural shapechangers; C mon.c:5522-5525 calls set_apparxy only when mon_moving and the apparent-hero coordinate is not the hero; the helper is monmove.c:2197-2245.
JS mon.js:566-578 imports multiple monmove.js functions but omits set_apparxy, while apply_newcham_steps calls it at line 3084. JS makemon_create.js:3194-3204 mirrors the C initial-shape call.
